scope.summary: Implement the UV layout authority (spec 13.22; PREQ-007/027): UDIM tiles (head/torso/limbs/genitals) published as a stable versioned target with per-tile texel-density priorities - genital, areola/nipple, and face tiles at hero px/cm tier - enforced by a texel-density validator (GREQ-011 pattern).
acceptance_criteria: UV layout published as a versioned authority artifact alongside the base mesh: UDIM tiles (head/torso/limbs/genitals) with per-tile texel-density targets recorded machine-readable (genital/areola/nipple and face at hero tier, limbs at standard tier per PREQ-027).
Texel-density validator computes px/cm per region at a reference texture size and fails when genital/areola density falls below hero tier or density varies beyond the documented ratio (GREQ-011).
Layout stability contract: any UV change requires a version bump plus migration note - the layout is a publishable ecosystem target (3D Scan Store precedent).
UDIM tile ids registered as typed constants consumed by the layer stack, bake, and blend MTs.
scope.risk_if_missed: Every skin MT and future third-party texture product depends on a stable published UV target; shipping without hero texel density on genital/areola tiles makes closeups - the shots adult production centers on - soft exactly where the camera lingers (PREQ-027).

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
